established_solution: Multivariable LDSC joint S,V; GenomicSEM defined parameters; full delta/Jacobian or valid joint block inference
assumptions: Positive variances away from zero; justified joint moment law/V; LD and population/reference compatibility; valid overlap/error model and genomic deletions

scientific_need: Avoid spurious ratio certainty and invalid weak-signal comparison
established_solution: General Fieller/confidence-set inversion; likelihood/profile methods; covariance tests; signal eligibility; HDL/HDL-L and SUPERGNOVA weak-local-r discussion
assumptions: Precisely declared fixed/random target/null; justified joint law and variance estimate; valid LD/reference; constraints; actual extreme-tail calibration

beyond_atlas_utility: Potential in other low-h2 GWAS, not demonstrated; no benchmarking admitted
stop_rule: Stop if target variance zero or identifiability absent; reopen only after precise gap/baseline failure and prospective calibration design

established_solution: Classical error invariance of rg; identified GenomicSEM models under constraints; PheMED relative multiplicative effect dilution; repeated-measure designs
